verdict.rationale: The main cross-merchant discovery path, ACS for agents, does let an AI interface "discover products" across sellers via Stripe-ingested feeds. But it is private preview and requires a seller-initiated OCA, which is effectively a partnership gate. The self-service route is the publicly published Link CLI, whose wallet guides include "Search products and complete payments with UCP", but that is only a single thin mention. Stripe Directory points agents to external providers for a task, which is also thin for this story. Missing for 10: generally available cross-merchant product search without private preview or seller-initiated OCA approval, documented search API/query semantics, keyless or self-service search evidence beyond a guide title, independent hands-on corroboration.
